title: Sweet Home Neo Geo Conversion
author: Ok_Sea790
selftext:
With the upcoming release of the Neo Geo AES Plus I thought bringing a Famicom horror classic to it would be good, I love the Neo Geo.

Originally released by Capcom in 1989 for the Famicom, Sweet Home is a survival-horror RPG that combines exploration, puzzle-solving, turn-based combat, and a haunting story set inside a mysterious mansion.

This project is my attempt to reimagine that classic experience with enhanced pixel art inspired by modern HD-2D remakes, while developing the game for the original SNK Neo Geo AES hardware.

My goal is to preserve the atmosphere, characters, exploration, and gameplay that made the original game memorable while giving its environments, character sprites, enemies, and visual effects a new level of detail.

Rather than simply recreating the original graphics at a higher resolution, I want to rebuild the game's environments from individual art assets, create updated character animations, and explore what the Neo Geo's powerful 2D sprite hardware can bring to the experience. Do know that I am using AI as I don't know exactly how this works. This is a game I really like and I didn't see anyone trying to remake this game.

Also, I am brand new to all of this so I am trying to learn how this works. I am using ChatGPT Codex with GPT-6 Astra and it works pretty well for me so far.  I'm still tweaking the art and game design.    Any suggestions to maybe make this smoother I would greatly appreciate it.
